name: Standard
description: Default governance for internal, non-regulated data. Standard audit logging, no elevated review gate.

name: PHI-Regulated
description: Elevated governance for protected health information: encrypted-at-rest by default, restricted egress, mandatory access review.

name: Public-Sector-Isolated
description: Air-gapped-style isolation for public-sector or highest-sensitivity workloads. No shared tenancy, no default external egress.
